scope: Forge only; reusable planning gate applies to every subsequent model
units: Normalized furnace body width = 1; physical scale unresolved until camper fit

axes.origin: furnace center at mounting-foot contact plane
axes.rotations: degrees, XYZ Euler; pipe axes specified by endpoints instead

measurementAuthority: Image pixels are manually estimated observations. All 3D numbers below are initial hypotheses, not measurements recovered from one image. No model generation until camera and component projections are validated.

camera.rule: Fit one shared camera to all rigid landmarks. Do not compensate for a camera mismatch by independently distorting components.

components.shape: continuous squat dome above short near-vertical lower wall
components.detail: Individually outlined angular stones, interlocking staggered joints; no five regular horizontal courses
components.unresolved: Each visible stone contour and depth must be enumerated before generation

components.shape: deep irregular round-headed arch, actual open cavity
components.detail: Near-vertical jambs, rounded crown; visible rear masonry and floor
components.unresolved: Trace opening contour and separate arch stones

components.detail: Worn broken edges rather than three identical beveled bricks

components.shape: short thick circular open iron ring
components.detail: Rounded irregular lip, front overlap plate and dome rivet; recessed inner aperture

components.shape: thick bent iron ribbon conforming to dome and wall
components.rotation: parallel-transport cross section along path; broad face outward
parallel-transport cross section along path; broad face outward

components.shape: curved iron bands crossing shoulder and lower body
components.unresolved: Trace each visible band path and overlaps; no automatic latitude rings

components.shape: rounded rectangular overlap plates with substantial domed heads
components.unresolved: Enumerate individual junction positions; reject unplaced repeaters

components.shape: short bent tabs with round through-holes
components.position: under individual structural straps at Z=0.0125
components.unresolved: Enumerate locations and hole centers; no continuous pedestal substitute

components.shape: two thick timber uprights with rounded irregular corners
components.detail: Uprights separated across Y, paired top and bottom shafts, washers, bosses, short brackets
components.unresolved: Yaw and center require projected shaft rising to image right as reference; prior +25/-25 guesses rejected

components.shape: closed fan bellows with four rounded lobes and curved upper shoulder
components.detail: Broad rear lobes contract to a finite-width throat; joined crease valleys, no disconnected pillow stack
components.unresolved: Trace upper/lower silhouettes and fold ridges; verify overlap with frame

components.shape: cylindrical shafts with stepped journals and rounded boss heads
components.position: rear frame top and bottom bearing centers
components.unresolved: Frame fit must place both shaft endpoints inside bearings

components.shape: exposed short thick cylinder between leather collar and furnace flange
components.position: between bellows throat and left furnace wall at Z=0.56
components.rotation: axis defined by connected collar/flange centers
components.detail: Collar rectangular with rounded corners; furnace flange circular with eight visible/occluded bolts

components.shape: hollow slightly tapered thick-walled vessel with gently chipped rim
components.detail: Broad open interior; softly irregular rim rather than sawtooth notches; floor thickness
components.relation: Forward of bellows, left of front strap; rim below nozzle; overlaps lower-right bellows in image

components.shape: two broad rounded metal hoops and vertical retaining straps
components.position: around crucible outer profile, with connector to furnace
components.rotation: hoops horizontal; straps vertical following taper
components.detail: Separate domed rivets, side coupling and support; no floating hardware
components.unresolved: Trace and enumerate visible strap and coupling placements

components.shape: irregular small rounded fractured lumps filling hearth floor
components.position: within hearth void above sill-bottom level
components.unresolved: Distribution and prominent silhouettes; do not use texture to replace shape

requiredBeforeBlender: Enumerate every repeated stone, rivet, band and mounting component with explicit transform
Project plan without Blender and compare landmarks/contours
Check attachment endpoints and occlusion order
validation.requiredBeforeTexture: Actual clay model matches validated plan and approved reference in whole assembly and component close-ups
validation.requiredBeforeUnity: Textured Blender model passes reference review; textures limited to 2048 square
validation.rule: Passing JSON/schema or numerical checks is not visual acceptance
